auditor.actual_model_source: This session started on anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 and was moved by provider quota (HTTP 429) through openai/gpt-6-astra and kimi/k3.1-pro to radient/auto, which the harness reports as this session's serving model (sessions info). radient/auto is a provider router whose backend id the harness does not expose, so none is claimed. auditor.independence_note: This session authored none of the 12 es values. They were handed over as bytes; the English source, the context sidecar and the sibling family were re-read and the judgement formed here.

verdict_reason: No BLOCKER or MAJOR on the bytes. All 12 values keep the English claim: what each agent is for and when to reach for it, with no omission, addition or polarity error, and the one restriction in the file (copy to user-visible text, never engineering prose or code comments) and the one constraint (scout is read-only, nothing is modified) survive intact. Register and terminology hold: infinitive openings and tu address per the es guide, 'agente', 'equipo', 'Biblioteca', 'solo lectura', 'porcion' and 'resumen del estado' agree with the sibling descriptions family. Kept-English tokens untouched: RFC, diff, pull request, merge request, ticket, CLI, daemon/daemons (es guide W2 amendment), unicode, and the C/D/T/U finding prefixes in the sibling. Both files are literal sentences with no ICU arguments, plurals, selects or markup, so placeholder and CLDR parity are vacuous; key parity is 12/12 in identical order; all targets NFC; three deliberate caps (COMO, ASPECTO, EXPERIENCIA) survive the emphasis the source carries. Length 1.05-1.21x English, inside the guide's 15-25% band, and the card truncates with an ellipsis by contract, so no overflow finding. The three MINORs and five NITs are wording improvements, not meaning faults.

findings.current: … descubribilidad, respuesta y mensajes de error, …
findings.problem: Calque of 'discoverability' that no es catalogue has used before, while the sibling family renders the same concept as 'descubrimiento' (ui.agents.descriptions.ux_reviewer). One concept, two words across two shipped agent surfaces; 'facilidad de descubrimiento' is the settled non-calque phrasing.
findings.suggestion: … facilidad de descubrimiento, respuesta y mensajes de error, … (or 'descubrimiento' to match the sibling blurb)

findings.current: Comprobar el ASPECTO de algo para el usuario: … — una ronda de diseño y UX sobre un cambio visible.
findings.problem: 'para el usuario' dangles after 'algo' and can be read as 'something made for the user' rather than 'how it looks TO the user'; the closing 'un cambio visible' also drops the 'para el usuario' qualifier the English carries.
findings.suggestion: Comprobar el ASPECTO que algo tiene para el usuario: … — una ronda de diseño y UX sobre un cambio visible para el usuario.

findings.current: Comprobar de forma independiente si un pull request, un parche o una funcionalidad funciona de verdad de principio a fin; …
findings.problem: This sentence is what search embeds, and the key's sidecar asks that the test trigger stay recognisable, but the value carries no 'probar/prueba' token (only 'funciona', 'error', 'regresiones') while the sibling blurb opens 'Prueba independiente'; it also reuses the designer's opening verb where English keeps 'testing' and 'checking' apart.
findings.suggestion: Probar de forma independiente si un pull request, un parche o una funcionalidad funciona de verdad de principio a fin; …

findings.problem: Lowercase 'unicode' where the technology name is officially 'Unicode'. Both families share the lowercase, so this is recorded rather than churned.

findings.current: … a diferencia de una revisión visual o de diseño de cómo se ve.
findings.problem: Two prepositional attachments ('de … de cómo se ve') hang off 'revisión'; understandable, but it is the card's last line and reads slightly tangled.
findings.suggestion: … a diferencia de una revisión visual o de diseño de su aspecto.

findings.current: … respaldo de las afirmaciones y tics de IA.
findings.problem: English 'stripping AI-isms' names an action; as a bare noun in the list the value says the agent is concerned with AI-isms rather than that it removes them. It mirrors the sibling blurb, so low priority.
findings.suggestion: … respaldo de las afirmaciones y eliminación de tics de IA.

findings.current: Coordinar y seguir trabajo de varias partes entre agentes o repositorios, …
findings.problem: 'partes' most often means parties or stakeholders in Spanish, so 'trabajo de varias partes' can read as 'work from several parties' instead of the English multi-part work.
findings.suggestion: Coordinar y seguir trabajo repartido en varias partes entre agentes o repositorios, …

findings.problem: 'una funcionalidad' and 'una función' sit two clauses apart and differ by a suffix, so 'añadir una función' (a code function) can be read back as one more feature.
findings.suggestion: … crear una funcionalidad, corregir un error o añadir una función al código — …
